title: Order Routing Output (vibe-eu-opc-ful-order-ops)
description: Output artifact cho 1 don sau verify -> route -> tracking theo SOP-FUL-001/002

market.description: Vung khach -> quyet dinh provider (US->US, EU->EU)

provider.description: Print provider da chon (Printify/PrintBase US hoac EU)

verify_status.description: PASS=route duoc; HOLD=cho fix (address/SKU/capture); FRAUD=escalate OPC, KHONG route

routed_within_h.description: Gio tu paid_at -> routed_at. SLO <=18h, ceiling hard-fail <=24h

tracking_sent.description: Da gui tracking EN cho khach chua (SLO <=6h sau fulfilled)

tracking_number.description: Tracking number tu provider (optional cho toi khi ship)

cost_pushed_backoffice.description: Da day print+ship cost sang 05-backoffice chua

evidence.description: Bang chung: order_id ShopBase, provider routing rule, tracking#, timestamps paid/routed/sent

confidence_score.description: Do tin cay quyet dinh; <0.7 -> need_review=true

need_review.description: true khi confidence<0.7 HOAC verify_status in {HOLD,FRAUD} HOAC routed_within_h>24
